Green：同一 coverage 命令 exit 0，報告所有 tracked test file 都被 reachable 或 named-exempt，且輸出 `20 passed, 0 failed, 0 falsification(s) skipped`；本票三支測試均由恰好一個語意 group reachable，沒有新增 allowlist、沒有刪除測試。targeted group-chain test exit 0，inventory 固定為 DEFAULT_TESTS=53 + OPTIONAL_TESTS=2 = 55，並明確包含 kg-board；兩個 owner group acceptance 亦須綠。
brief: 整合檢查會因三支既有測試沒有語意歸屬而阻塞，維護者無法信任測試覆蓋判決。
detail: Quiet fresh Gate evidence (2026-08-10): the first rebuild Gate had 11 pass and 1 block; ops-ci-coverage reported three tracked test files as unreachable and observed concurrent xcodebuild pid=17976. After the Supervisor-confirmed quiet window, the same command exited 1 with 19 passed and 3 failed, with no concurrent iOS process. The three failures were ops/tests/test_kg_board_model.py, ops/tests/test_kg_board_web.py, and ops/tests/test_lock_wait.py. Read-only inspection showed no DEFAULT_TESTS run_one path for those files. They are real offline tests: the first two belong to the KG board owner; the lock test belongs to the worktree/coordination owner. The fix must register each in exactly one semantic group; it must not use UNGROUPED_TESTS or delete tests.
fix_site:
ops/test_ops.sh: DEFAULT_TESTS/run_one（kg-board 與 worktree-orchestrator 的真實測試歸屬）
ops/tests/test_ops_ci_coverage.sh: LINUX_GROUPS（新 group 的 CI 分類契約）
ops/tests/test_ops_group_chain.py: case_arms inventory（新增 kg-board group 的 dispatcher contract）
plan: 先以 ops/tests/test_ops_ci_coverage.sh 的 deterministic 紅結果釘住三個 tracked test 必須被恰好一個語意 group 收納；再把 kg_board model/web 放入正式 kg-board group，將 lock_wait 放入既有 worktree-orchestrator group，並把新 group 納入 DEFAULT_TESTS 與 LINUX_GROUPS。同步更新 ops/tests/test_ops_group_chain.py 的 dispatcher inventory：DEFAULT_TESTS=53、OPTIONAL_TESTS=2、case_arms=55，且明確 assert kg-board membership，避免只改魔術數字。最後執行 targeted group-chain RED→GREEN、coverage contract、兩個受影響 group 與 fresh Gate；不得改 UNGROUPED_TESTS、不得刪測試。
scope: 小型：一個維運測試 dispatcher 與它的 coverage contract，新增兩個分類路徑並補一個既有 group 的測試歸屬。
